sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS french_drivers_count
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
AND CAST(SUBSTR(l.time, 6, 2) || SUBSTR(l.time, 9) AS INTEGER) < 120
